sha256-fd-v1:b1152cae40f580a91cc9fae3316.description: Follow apprentice sorceress Arle through three linked first-person dungeon RPGs at different stages of her life. Spell choices and status conveyed through portraits replace the usual visible statistic display.

sha256-fd-v1:b131d0970c105a5d0e6830b19f6.description: Saiko travels across a board-like map and challenges magical creatures at mahjong. Shops, treasure, and other spaces give the matches a light role-playing framework.
sha256-fd-v1:b131d0970c105a5d0e6830b19f6.title: Ma Saiko Jan
